name: adidas Yeezy Boost 750 'OG'
story_html: Kanye West’s very first collaborative adidas shoe, the Yeezy Boost 750 ‘OG’ released worldwide February 2015 in extremely limited quantities. The towering boot-like builds showcases a radical departure from West’s previous designs, featuring a light brown all-suede upper mounted atop a partially ribbed, Boost-equipped rubber tooling in a subtle Off-White shade. The minimalist design is accented with oversized rope laces, perforated detailing on the toe box, and a wide midfoot strap in a tonal twill fabrication. A hidden zipper on the lateral side provides easy on and off.
